cases.description: A trailing comma omits the required second positional argument. VBE Compile rejects this as a syntax error.
cases.source:
Public Function InvoiceTotal(ByVal Subtotal As Currency, ByVal TaxRate As Double) As Currency
    InvoiceTotal = Subtotal + (Subtotal * TaxRate)
End Function

Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim total As Double
    Dim total2 As Double
    total = 100
    total2 = InvoiceTotal(total, )
End Sub

cases.description: A leading comma omits the required first positional argument. VBE Compile rejects this as Argument not optional.
cases.source:
Public Function InvoiceTotal(ByVal Subtotal As Currency, ByVal TaxRate As Double) As Currency
    InvoiceTotal = Subtotal + (Subtotal * TaxRate)
End Function

Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim total2 As Double
    total2 = InvoiceTotal(, 0.08)
End Sub

cases.description: A trailing comma omits an Optional argument. This is initially observe-only until the VBE oracle records behavior.
cases.source:
Public Function InvoiceTotal(ByVal Subtotal As Currency, Optional ByVal TaxRate As Double = 0.08) As Currency
    InvoiceTotal = Subtotal + (Subtotal * TaxRate)
End Function

Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim total As Double
    Dim total2 As Double
    total = 100
    total2 = InvoiceTotal(total, )
End Sub

cases.description: A bare local variable statement is rejected by VBE Compile as Expected Sub, Function, or Property.
cases.source:
Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim testStr As String
    testStr = "hello"
    testStr
End Sub

cases.description: A local String variable followed by an argument-looking string literal.
cases.source:
Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim testStr As String
    testStr = "hello"
    testStr "hello"
End Sub

cases.description: VBA can coerce a numeric literal into a String variable.
cases.source:
Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim testStr As String
    testStr = 123
End Sub

Public Function InvoiceTotal(ByVal Subtotal As Currency, ByVal TaxRate As Double) As Currency
    InvoiceTotal = Subtotal + (Subtotal * TaxRate)
End Function

Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim total2 As Double
    total2 = InvoiceTotal(100, 0.08)
End Sub
